name: retalk-inbox
description: Pushes this session's incoming retalk messages into the session as they arrive (per-user, resolved via the session->user map that init writes). Run `receive follow <peer>` to start the follower that feeds the spool.

name: retalk-requests
description: Pushes this session's incoming contact requests into the session as they arrive: peers who presented one of this identity's invite codes and were registered as contacts. Run the invite watcher from the `id` skill to start the follower that feeds the request spool.
